cases.title: Discard password on Never For This Site selection
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password and does not save it when Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Available choices for multiple saved usernames and passwords
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords are saved for a website, all those choices are later available and presented correctly.

cases.title: Update password when changed
cases.description: Verify that when a saved password is changed and submitted, the password manager picks up and updates to the new password.

cases.title: Disabling password manager stops prompts and prefill
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager is disabled from the preferences panel, the browser no longer asks to save passwords and stops prefilling info on sites.

cases.title: View saved credentials in preferences
cases.description: Verify that saved username and password information can be successfully viewed in the password manager through the preferences panel.

cases.title: Remove specific site credentials
cases.description: Verify that removing a username and password for a given site results in no autofill on that site and removes the entry from the password manager list.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information
cases.description: Verify that removing all username and password information clears everything so that nothing is listed in the password manager and autofill no longer occurs.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are distinct, thoroughly cover the given requirements, have clear expected behaviors, and are fully testable without any identified blockers.
All cases and expected behaviors accurately correspond to the provided requirements with no blockers identified.

analysis.analysis: R-102: Testable behavior is discarding credentials upon 'Never For This Site' selection; normal path is clicking 'Never', abnormal path is saving anyway; boundary is immediate memory/storage wipe. R-103: Testable behavior is storing and retrieving multiple credentials per site; normal path is listing all saved accounts; ambiguity is how choices are presented when multiple exist. R-104: Testable behavior is updating stored passwords upon change; normal path is prompt to update or auto-detection on submit; abnormal path is keeping the old password. R-105: Testable behavior is disabling prompts and prefill when preferences are off; normal path is zero prompts/prefill; boundary is toggle state change. R-106: Testable behavior is viewing saved credentials via preferences; normal path is navigating to preferences list; abnormal path is missing entries. R-107: Testable behavior is deleting specific site credentials; normal path is removal from list and no autofill; boundary is single-entry deletion. R-108: Testable behavior is wiping all stored credentials; normal path is 'Clear All' action resulting in empty manager and no autofill; boundary is complete data purge.
